scope: General sports-plugin ecosystem; BSI product remains college baseball only.
measurementLimits: Install/load, explicit invocation, natural-language triggering and useful-answer accuracy are separate measurements.
A source URL or passing arithmetic alone does not prove substantive factual support.
The catalog contains proposed evaluation requests, not benchmark results.

cases.prompt: Summarize Texas baseball's most recent available team record with explicit season and coverage dates.
cases.expectedBehavior: Block a current-season record if source coverage is unspecified.

cases.prompt: Prepare a sourced Texas versus LSU series preview for the next scheduled series.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve both teams and dates; do not fabricate a future matchup.

cases.prompt: Explain Texas's first SEC baseball season with primary-source support.
cases.expectedBehavior: Distinguish institutional entry from baseball competition.

cases.prompt: Assess Texas pitching using ERA and FIP when the published inputs are available.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require innings, strikeouts, walks, home runs and season-specific FIP constant.

cases.prompt: Evaluate a Texas hitter's wOBA and describe sample-size limitations.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require event counts and published league/season coefficients.

cases.prompt: Compare Texas home and road performance for one explicitly identified season.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require the actual splits; no undocumented park adjustment.

cases.prompt: Build a Texas postgame packet for the most recent completed game.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve final/live/disrupted status and unavailable scores.

cases.prompt: Write a Texas recruiting story briefing using public sourced information.
cases.expectedBehavior: No private, psychological or unsupported draft-probability claims.

cases.prompt: Find conflicting Texas records across two supplied sources and explain the disagreement.
cases.expectedBehavior: Retain both values and coverage scopes; do not silently pick one.

cases.prompt: Create a Texas editorial briefing when the standings tool times out.
cases.expectedBehavior: Return an explicit partial result and preserve other successful evidence.

cases.prompt: Resolve the NCAA baseball identities for Miami Florida and Miami Ohio.
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not conflate programs or rely on approximate matching.

cases.prompt: Prepare an Arkansas versus Oregon State baseball comparison for a named season.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use season-matched data; state unavailable historical coverage.

cases.prompt: Compare the SEC and ACC in college baseball without inventing a power index.
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer strength of schedule from standings alone.

cases.prompt: Calculate a college baseball team's winning percentage from sourced wins and losses.
cases.expectedBehavior: Trace numerator and denominator to preserved source fields.

cases.prompt: Calculate college baseball wRC+ when league runs and park factor are missing.
cases.expectedBehavior: Block the calculation or clearly label a different supported metric.

cases.prompt: Calculate FIP for a college pitcher whose innings are recorded as baseball outs.
cases.expectedBehavior: Convert .1 and .2 innings correctly; reject invalid fractional outs.

cases.prompt: Compare a mid-major pitcher's strikeout and walk rates with a national baseline.
cases.expectedBehavior: Match season, level, denominator and baseline provenance.

cases.prompt: Explain whether a college hitter's high BABIP establishes a sustainable skill.
cases.expectedBehavior: Separate observation from inference; do not claim calibrated talent probability.

cases.prompt: Produce a preview for a postponed college baseball game.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report postponement and avoid inventing a replacement start time.

cases.prompt: Produce a live recap for a suspended college baseball game with a score.
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not name a final winner, final margin or unsupported live leader.

cases.prompt: Compare a Division I team's current season with a historical season.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve season and rule/context differences without fabricated normalization.

cases.prompt: Build a player briefing when two players share the same name.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require unique identity and avoid merging records.

cases.prompt: Summarize NCAA baseball rankings with publication date and ranking organization.
cases.expectedBehavior: Differentiate polls and preserve conflicting rankings.

cases.prompt: Calculate team run differential from sourced runs scored and runs allowed.
cases.expectedBehavior: Cross-check source fields and preserve unknown values.

cases.prompt: Describe the national Division I landscape when only conference standings are available.
cases.expectedBehavior: Limit conclusions to the available coverage and identify missing conferences.

cases.prompt: Calculate a college quarterback's NCAA passing efficiency from a sourced box score.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the NCAA formula and all required inputs.

cases.prompt: Explain why NFL passer rating and NCAA efficiency cannot be silently substituted.
cases.expectedBehavior: Label the formula, level and output units.

cases.prompt: Compare two college football offenses using sourced EPA per play.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require the actual EPA model/data and denominator.

cases.prompt: Estimate offensive success rate when only a final box score is available.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report unavailable play-level data; no substituted success rate.

cases.prompt: Prepare a college football matchup briefing with explicitly dated sources.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve teams, schedule and season; label interpretation.

cases.prompt: Create a college football recap from a final score of zero to zero.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve supplied zero scores and any unusual final state.

cases.prompt: Handle a cancelled college football game in a game-day evidence packet.
cases.expectedBehavior: No winner or final margin; source the status.

cases.prompt: Compare a quarterback's early-season performance to a prior full season.
cases.expectedBehavior: Discuss sample sizes and retain season scope.

cases.prompt: Write an editorial note about a college football coaching change.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use primary announcements; distinguish reports from confirmation.

cases.prompt: Respond to a college football data endpoint returning an error page.
cases.expectedBehavior: Make the tool failure explicit; do not manufacture a statistical table.

cases.prompt: Calculate true shooting percentage from a sourced basketball box score.
cases.expectedBehavior: Trace points, FGA and FTA and label the free-throw coefficient.

cases.prompt: Compute offensive and defensive rating using an explicitly defined possessions estimate.
cases.expectedBehavior: Label estimate, coefficients and consistent units.

cases.prompt: Compare NBA and NCAA basketball possessions estimates.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use level-specific context; no unlabeled formula substitution.

cases.prompt: Explain a team's Four Factors using season-matched source data.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require every factor input and its denominator.

cases.prompt: Prepare a college basketball preview with missing injury information.
cases.expectedBehavior: State availability limits; no invented player status.

cases.prompt: Summarize a live basketball score without treating it as final.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve the clock/status and label provisional outcomes.

cases.prompt: Assess a player's scoring efficiency over a very small sample.
cases.expectedBehavior: Retain uncertainty and avoid unsupported forecast probability.

cases.prompt: Compare two basketball players who have changed teams.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve identity, season and team scope before combining records.

cases.prompt: Write a sourced basketball historical comparison across different eras.
cases.expectedBehavior: State rule/context limitations and avoid uncalibrated era adjustment.

cases.prompt: Calculate shooting percentages when attempts are zero or unavailable.
cases.expectedBehavior: Return undefined/unavailable appropriately; never silently use zero.

cases.prompt: Audit an article whose numerical claim cites a source that contains a different number.
cases.expectedBehavior: Fail substantive source support even if a source ID is present.

cases.prompt: Audit a quotation that differs by one word from the supplied source excerpt.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reject nonmatching quotation; do not silently rewrite the source.

cases.prompt: Review an undated statistical page retrieved today for a current-season article.
cases.expectedBehavior: Distinguish retrieval freshness from statistical coverage.

cases.prompt: Prepare a briefing from two conflicting official sources and one opinion column.
cases.expectedBehavior: Separate verified observations, inference and opinion; keep conflicts visible.

cases.prompt: Create a publication review packet when one required tool is unavailable.
cases.expectedBehavior: Show the failure, unresolved checks and human review requirement; no automatic publication.
